## English

### Description
Bot brain-layer framework required by SAIN, Looting Bots, and Questing Bots Continuous.

### Settings
No end-user gameplay config.

### Notes
Install: `BepInEx/plugins/DrakiaXYZ-BigBrain.dll`. Debug DLL is intentionally excluded from the pack.
